correctness.rationale: For f=x²exp(r-x)+k and q=2+sqrt2, r_c=q-log(2+2sqrt2), exact evaluation gives f(q)=q, multiplier -1, f’’(q)=0, f’’’(q)=2/q. The symmetric equations H1=[f(m+A)+f(m-A)]/2-m=0 and H2=[f(m+A)-f(m-A)]/(2A)+1=0, analytically extended in U=A², have nonsingular (m,U) Jacobian diag(-2,1/(3q)). Implicit differentiation gives U_r=3q,U_k=0,U_kk=-3/2, hence the quoted parabolic two-parameter cap and unique local cycle. Independent symbolic derivatives, independent two-cycle numeric roots across detunings and multipliers confirm the local attracting branch. The critical iterate f²(q+z)=q+z-(2/(3q))z³+O(z⁴) forces n(x_n-q)^2→3q/2 for sufficiently nearby nonfixed orbits. Claimed effects are local; excluded outside |t|>2sqrt(q) follows from U<0. Boundary parameter t=±2sqrt q is deliberately not covered by the fixed-t interior/exterior assertions.
residual_risks: Local parameter uniformity and stability follow analytically from the IFT and positive cubic saturation; finite root tests do not establish global attracting basins.
